Goldogram offline master-key generator

Creates the same 12 words, GOGMK1 master QR, 4-word passphrase, and printable PDF as in-app registration — with no network. Also builds a public registration code (addresses and public keys only).

You appear to be online. This tool refuses to generate while the browser reports a network connection. Disconnect, enable airplane mode, or confirm you understand the risk.

Generate

Entropy uses crypto.getRandomValues only (never Math.random). Optionally mix in your own randomness below (dice rolls or typed text); it is hashed together with OS entropy.

Store these separately

4-word passphrase — secret. It decrypts the master QR (Argon2id + AES-GCM). It is not a second login factor on the server and not a fingerprint. Write it on paper, never with the QR. Strength ≈ 2048⁴ ≈ 2⁴⁴ bits (~44 bits) against offline guessing of a stolen QR.

12-word seed — the master secret. Shown once. Anyone with these words controls the account. Prefer the encrypted QR + passphrase for daily backup; keep the 12 words as a separate recovery copy if you write them at all.

Master key QR (GOGMK1) — encrypted seed. Safe to print alone; useless without the 4 words.

Spending key QR (GOGSK1) — encrypted spend ξ only. Own 4 words (below). Cannot derive the master seed. Use this to install the spending wallet after public registration.
